moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.description: List characters, pick one and apply kick, jail, ban or teleport.
moderation.searchText: Filter by nick, L2 account login or email stored in the game.
moderation.pick: Choose a character in the list to see the actions.
moderation.unavailable: Game-database moderation is not available on this server.
moderation.onlineHint: The character is in the world. Kick, jail and teleport in the database apply on the next login; a ban blocks relogin.
moderation.noLogs: There are no recorded actions on this character yet.
moderation.minutesHint: 0 keeps the jail until an unjail.

confirmText.kick: Marks the character offline in the game database. If they are online, the actual disconnect depends on the gameserver.
confirmText.jail: Moves them to the GM jail and stores the reason. Online characters only enter jail on the next login.
confirmText.unjail: Clears the jail and sends the character to Giran.
confirmText.ban: Sets a negative access level on the L2 account. Blocks the next login.
confirmText.unban: Restores the account access level to player (0).
confirmText.teleport: Moves the offline character (or on next login) to the chosen town.

toast.onlinePending: The character was online: position and kick apply on the next login.

secrets.title: Secrets and rotation
secrets.description: Key status, soft-rotate and reencrypt. Superadmins only.
secrets.summaryDescription: Fallback TTL, automatic rotation and whether the panel may write .env.
secrets.inventoryDescription: Fingerprints only — plaintext values never appear here.
secrets.runtimeOff: PDL_ALLOW_RUNTIME_SECRET_ROTATION is off: .env actions stay pending until ./setup.sh configure-production --apply-pending-rotations (or manage.py apply_secret_rotations).
secrets.restartPending: An applied rotation still needs backend/asgi/celery recreate.
secrets.restartHint: Recreate backend/asgi/celery so every worker loads the new SECRET_KEY.
secrets.bannerAttention: {{count}} item(s) need review (prune, restart or queue).
secrets.pendingHint: Apply on the host with manage.py apply_secret_rotations or configure-production --apply-pending-rotations.
secrets.actionsDescription: Pick one operation, confirm the domain, then run. One at a time.

kindHints.rotate_secret_key: New primary key; the previous one moves to SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS.
kindHints.prune_secret_fallbacks: Drops old keys after the grace window.
kindHints.rotate_data_encryption_key: MultiFernet: new primary, old key as fallback.
kindHints.reencrypt_sealed_data: Rewrites TOTP, recovery codes and LGPD packages with the primary.
kindHints.prune_data_fallbacks: Only after reencrypt — otherwise sealed data becomes unreadable.
kindHints.rotate_backup_encryption_key: New dumps use the new key; older keys still decrypt legacy dumps.

themes.title: PDL themes
themes.description: Install the ZIP and pick the landing template on the package. Activate applies the identity to the site.
themes.installDescription: Upload a validated ZIP. After install, pick the template on the package card. Installing does not activate the theme.
themes.fileHint: ZIP up to 32 MB, PDL 2.0 schema.
themes.securityNote: Superadministrators only. The default theme is never overwritten.
themes.compatibleDescription: Packages in the installable PDL 2.0 format, with the manifest at the ZIP root.

rules.files: Files at the root: <c>theme.json</c>, <c>theme.css</c>, optional <c>metadados.json</c> and <c>locales/</c>, folders <c>images/</c> and <c>fonts/</c>
rules.accepted: Accepted: CSS, images, local fonts, <c>metadados.json</c> and <c>locales/{pt,en,es}.json</c> pointed to by <c>theme.json</c>
rules.blocked: Blocked: scripts, executable HTML, Markdown and path traversal
rules.renderer: Catalog of 20 layouts (Vesperlyn, Ironspine, Warhorn…) or aliases <c>portal-v1</c> and <c>club-v1</c>
rules.activation: Installing ≠ activating: activate it in the catalog after validation

themes.templateHint: Changes the layout only. Brand, copy and art stay with the package.

customItems.description: New items with their own identity, integrated into the catalog used across the panel.

customItems.searchLabel: Search customs by name or ID
customItems.emptyText: Register the name, ID, image and metadata. The new item will show up in panel searches.
customItems.conflict: This ID also exists in the XML. The XML takes priority in the catalog.
customItems.imageHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP · up to 2 MB · up to 1024 × 1024
customItems.gameIdLockedHint: The ID is permanent so references stay valid.
customItems.gameIdHint: Use a free ID that is not in the XML yet.
customItems.name: Name
customItems.metadataHint: E.g.: {"rarity":"rare","description":"Event currency"}. Up to 16 KB. This data is public: do not include passwords or secrets.
customItems.footerNote: Deactivating preserves the registration and the image.
customItems.readonlyOnly: Your access only allows viewing custom items.
customItems.imageTooLarge: The image must be up to 2 MB.
customItems.invalidJson: The metadata must be valid JSON.
customItems.objectRequired: Use a JSON object in the metadata, such as {"rarity": "rare"}.
customItems.imageRequired: Select an image to register the item.

descriptions.balances: Available balances, bonuses and history consistency for each user.
descriptions.cashFlow: Daily wallet credits and debits, with the accumulated balance for the period.

explanations.payments: Period based on the order creation date. BRL and USD totals are independent. Credited coins and bonuses only count confirmed orders. Simulations stay pending until staff confirms them in admin; players cannot credit themselves.
explanations.cashFlow: Values in wallet coins. Includes bonuses and internal transfers; it does not represent cash revenue. The accumulated total starts at zero at the beginning of the filtered period.
explanations.balances: Values in wallet coins. Total balance = principal + bonus; balance by history = credits − debits. Differences up to 0.01 are consistent; up to 1.00 are under review. This query does not change balances.

metrics.ordersFoundDetail: Every order matching the applied filters
